note: 20 scenario-specific guided website blueprints. Sections are ordered hypotheses, not compulsory page modules. AI/3D optional.

blueprints.title: Engineering portfolio
blueprints.audience: Hiring managers, founders and technical teammates
blueprints.goal: Assess engineering judgment and open a real project
blueprints.thesis: A quiet technical field journal: inspectable work before ornamental self-promotion
blueprints.ai: Optional scoped project Q&A after case studies, never as the only navigation
blueprints.threeD: Usually no; only an optional product-specific visualization with image and plain-text fallback
blueprints.notes: No stock headshot needed. Show source, contribution, constraints, honest screenshots, repo/demo links, architecture and measurable results when documented.

blueprints.title: Designer / creative portfolio
blueprints.goal: Understand visual craft, process and real delivered work
blueprints.thesis: Curated exhibition with project context and process evidence
blueprints.ai: Optional portfolio finder for a large archive, after categories and filters work
blueprints.threeD: Optional interaction study or spatial art stage if it actually demonstrates the designer's capability
blueprints.notes: Show role and collaborators. Keep navigation and case-study text legible. Motion should not hide imagery or client proof.

blueprints.title: Startup company site
blueprints.goal: Find out what the company does, why trust it and how to contact
blueprints.thesis: Credible company story anchored in a concrete customer problem
blueprints.ai: Optional sales/support assistant in help or contact, with truthful limits and human escalation
blueprints.threeD: Avoid unless product hardware or visual interaction requires it
blueprints.notes: No invented team, funding or clients. Include legal/company identity only when verified; accessible contact path should not depend on chat.

blueprints.title: Enterprise corporate site
blueprints.goal: Verify services, governance, credibility, support and operations
blueprints.thesis: A documented institution: evidence and pathways beat inflated slogans
blueprints.ai: Scoped documentation retrieval after clear contact and searchable resources
blueprints.threeD: Avoid by default; reduce enterprise bandwidth and cognitive load
blueprints.notes: Provide clear security, compliance and contact details only if real. Distinguish press, careers, investor and product destinations.

blueprints.title: SaaS product landing page
blueprints.goal: Understand the product, try a genuine workflow and see terms
blueprints.thesis: The software itself is the hero; show one honest workflow
blueprints.ai: Offer AI only as actual product capability, not a floating sales bot by default
blueprints.threeD: Usually no. A real working product demo is stronger than ornamental CGI
blueprints.notes: Do not simulate integrations as real. Make onboarding and checkout link functional; optimize first visitor understanding.

blueprints.title: B2B platform / integration site
blueprints.goal: Validate integration, risk, documentation and support
blueprints.thesis: A systems map with real documented capabilities
blueprints.ai: Searchable docs assistant alongside canonical docs links and code examples
blueprints.threeD: Only if an interactive topology is clearer than an accessible 2D diagram
blueprints.notes: Separate SDK docs from marketing promises. Include runnable snippets, auth scopes and real supported providers.

blueprints.title: Consumer digital product site
blueprints.goal: Experience the product benefit and understand pricing/privacy
blueprints.thesis: A humane product story, demonstrated by real moments
blueprints.ai: Only if the consumer product genuinely requires AI to accomplish a task
blueprints.threeD: Optional brand illustration; must not obscure CTA or readability
blueprints.notes: Real app screenshots, permissions, terms and store destinations; no fake ratings or feature claims.

blueprints.title: Ecommerce product detail
blueprints.goal: Judge fit, variant, total cost, delivery and return conditions
blueprints.thesis: A product decision sheet with truthful visual evidence
blueprints.ai: Optional sizing/spec finder after direct filters and customer support work
blueprints.threeD: Useful for physical shape/fit with user-controlled rotation and photo/spec fallback
blueprints.notes: Visible stock, shipping, dimensions, returns and exact chosen variant; keyboard gallery and mobile action.

blueprints.title: Marketplace / store catalog
blueprints.goal: Search, narrow, compare and navigate back without losing filters
blueprints.thesis: An efficient discovery index with useful distinctions
blueprints.ai: Optional semantic search only if ordinary facets fail and results stay explainable
blueprints.threeD: Keep listings fast; restrict 3D to a detail page as optional progressive enhancement
blueprints.notes: Search state should persist between catalog and detail. Transparent out-of-stock, pricing and sorting.

blueprints.title: Creative / development agency
blueprints.goal: See expertise, specific outcomes, process and contact
blueprints.thesis: Case-file portfolio with authorship and clear working method
blueprints.ai: Optional project estimator with assumptions disclosed, not a bogus fixed quote
blueprints.threeD: Suitable only as a restrained original craft showcase with skip and static view
blueprints.notes: Name team role and real engagement types. If no testimonials, use transparent process and public work instead.

blueprints.title: Publication / book editorial
blueprints.goal: Find a work, read a real excerpt and subscribe or purchase
blueprints.thesis: The typography and the words are the artwork
blueprints.ai: Optional topic/library recommender after browse and conventional search
blueprints.threeD: Physical book reveal optional, but never interfere with readable excerpts or page navigation
blueprints.notes: Support sample chapters, genres, series, author context, publication status and regional availability truthfully.

blueprints.title: Learning / course website
blueprints.goal: Judge outcomes, curriculum level, format and purchase/registration
blueprints.thesis: Curriculum map before glossy certificate marketing
blueprints.ai: Optional study-plan guide if it knows the real syllabus and cites lesson sources
blueprints.threeD: Only for teachable manipulable spatial subjects (anatomy, geometry), not a default LMS hero
blueprints.notes: Show prerequisites, lessons, total commitment, instructor credibility, access, refunds and completion criteria.

blueprints.title: Nonprofit / mission site
blueprints.goal: Understand mission, impact evidence, donation and participation
blueprints.thesis: Human testimony and audited evidence before dramatic effects
blueprints.ai: Usually skip. Direct service eligibility and safety contacts matter more
blueprints.threeD: Avoid heavy visuals; prioritize low bandwidth, inclusive access and credible impact charts
blueprints.notes: Do not invent beneficiary stories or impact stats. Publish privacy/consent and donation fee terms.

blueprints.title: Local service business
blueprints.audience: Nearby customers needing an appointment or location
blueprints.goal: Find service area, availability, trust signals and booking
blueprints.thesis: Practical location-and-service guide with immediate next step
blueprints.ai: Skip unless appointment questions truly exceed FAQ and phone access
blueprints.threeD: No, unless physical property walkthrough is genuinely useful
blueprints.notes: Use verified address, hours, phone, accessibility, service boundaries; no fictional reviews or availability.

blueprints.title: Conference / event registration
blueprints.audience: Attendees and speakers planning a visit
blueprints.goal: Read accurate schedule, place, speakers and register
blueprints.thesis: A readable program that behaves like a ticket and timetable
blueprints.ai: Optional schedule assistant grounded in actual program and changes
blueprints.threeD: Venue walkthrough only if navigation requires it; show 2D map and address fallback
blueprints.notes: Display timezone for every session and cancellation/change policy, don't invent speakers or countdowns.

blueprints.title: Developer documentation / API portal
blueprints.goal: Find correct version, authentication, code example and troubleshoot
blueprints.thesis: An indexed lab notebook with executable examples
blueprints.ai: Contextual retrieval tied to docs versions with links and 'I don't know' fallback
blueprints.threeD: Only for actual spatial/systems explanation, never as a docs navigation replacement
blueprints.notes: Version tags, SDK languages, API limits, error codes, request scope and real results. No fake 'live terminal'.

blueprints.title: Multi-product company and subdomain hub
blueprints.audience: Users moving between a parent brand and distinct products
blueprints.goal: Recognize destinations, ownership, account boundaries and return routes
blueprints.thesis: A consistent family of independent product identities
blueprints.ai: Per-product scoped assistant with explicit domain/context handoff, never ambient cross-property spying
blueprints.threeD: Prefer consistent brand system, not 3D transition between domains
blueprints.notes: e.g. brand.example / app.brand.example / docs.brand.example / help.brand.example. Choose subdomain for independently deployed application or permission boundary; path for closely related content if simpler. Explicit cookie scope, CORS, CSP, session and privacy rules. Do not assume Google treats both as identical for SEO.

blueprints.title: AI-first product website
blueprints.audience: People evaluating an assistant, creator or AI workflow
blueprints.goal: Understand data use, what AI can do, reliability and pricing
blueprints.thesis: A transparent capability demonstrator, not magic chat bubbles
blueprints.ai: Core feature only when validated; model limitations, sources, permissions and user approval visible
blueprints.threeD: No unless AI product creates/manipulates real spatial assets
blueprints.notes: Show honest local/cloud route, trial/account requirements, model uncertainty, failure recovery and safety boundaries.

blueprints.title: Travel / hotel booking
blueprints.audience: Travelers weighing destinations, rooms and dates
blueprints.goal: Understand rooms, total cost, location and change policy
blueprints.thesis: A calm travel decision board with honest date and cost context
blueprints.ai: Optional itinerary helper only when it uses verified opening times and can cite details
blueprints.threeD: Optional 360 room tour with photo/list accessibility fallback
blueprints.notes: Live inventory only when backend confirms it. Mark sample results; disclose taxes, deposit, cancellation, accessibility.

blueprints.title: Creator / entertainment channel
blueprints.goal: Watch or read a real sample and find the next release
blueprints.thesis: A cinematic library that prioritizes the creator's work
blueprints.ai: Optional archive finder; no synthetic fan comments
blueprints.threeD: Cinematic title graphics optional, with motion/pause controls and no autoplay audio
blueprints.notes: Respect audio consent, captions, performance budget and real release dates.
